context: Tests the third state of the design-tool gate: not installed at all (vs. installed-but-not-enabled, covered by a sibling eval). The agent must distinguish 'never installed' from 'installed but disabled', stop, point the human at excat's own setup instructions rather than reproducing or running them, reverify with --check, and never hand-roll the rebrand as a substitute.

checklist.name: Stops rather than proceeding
checklist.description: The agent does not proceed into design-token work; it stops and reports the plugin is unavailable before doing any rebrand work.

checklist.name: Correctly identifies not-installed (not just disabled)
checklist.description: The agent's explanation reflects that the plugin was never installed — it does not say the plugin is 'already installed, just enable it' or otherwise imply install-then-enable is unnecessary.

checklist.name: Points at excat's own setup instructions
checklist.description: The agent directs the human to excat's CLI setup instructions (https://github.com/Adobe-AEM-Foundation/aem-experience-catalyst#cli-interface-setup-instructions) and/or docs/excat-setup.md. It does not reproduce a forked copy of those commands, which drifts from the original.

checklist.name: Does not install excat itself
checklist.description: The agent does NOT run git clone, npm run install:all, or npx . via Bash. Installing excat is one-time human machine setup; SKILL.md forbids a git clone or npm install at run time.

checklist.name: Requires reverify with --check
checklist.description: The agent says to restart the CLI if needed and to reverify with scripts/rebrand/extract-brand.mjs --check before continuing — not with claude plugin list or a file-existence check, which pass on a machine that still has no browser.

checklist.name: No hand-rolled rebrand
checklist.description: The agent does not edit styles.css, sweep hardcoded colors, or rewrite content itself as a substitute for the design skill.

checklist.name: Rebrand phase left blocked
checklist.description: The rebrand phase is not marked done and no design-tokens-applied/asset-colors-swept/content-register-rewritten step is marked done.
